name: Timber wall: treated posts and horizontal boards
in_game: New: a bank kind for older lots and small coves (HouseKit, by seed)
real: Treated pine piles 8 in across every 8 ft, 2x10 boards stacked behind them, a cap board on top. Weathered silver-grey, boards bowed and gapped, posts out of plumb, darker and slimed below the pool.
